The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm. The food on it is a small piece of breaded or fried chicken, roughly 8x5 cm, and a pile of arugula salad with some almond slivers and blueberries.

The chicken piece probably weighs about 85 g. At roughly 220 kcal per 100 g for breaded, fried chicken, that is about 190 kcal.

The arugula pile is about 15 cm across, and a loose pile like that is probably 60 g of greens. Add about 10 g of almonds, 10 g of blueberries, and some dressing. The salad comes to about 80 kcal for the greens and toppings, plus roughly 40 kcal from the oil dressing, so about 120 kcal.

Together that is about 165 g of food and about 310 kcal.
